item.title: Township approves municipal website upgrade
item.description: Fenton Township is working to make the municipal website more handicap accessible. On Tuesday, Jan., 20, the Fenton Township Board of Trustees approved a proposal to make the township’s website compliant with new Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) requirements. The vote was 6-0. Treasurer John Tucker was absent.
